name: openrig
description: Multi-agent harness that runs Claude Code and Codex together as one system
one_liner: A command-line tool that lets a developer run several AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex) together as one organized team instead of juggling a pile of separate terminal windows.
buyer: A solo developer or small dev team already running multiple AI coding agents in parallel who wants one dashboard instead of a dozen unmanaged terminal sessions.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer runs an 'owner + checker' rig on client repos to ship more features per week while personally reviewing only the final diffs.
A dev tooling consultant sets up and configures OpenRig rigs for engineering teams adopting AI coding agents at scale, as a paid setup service.
An engineering manager uses it to monitor multiple agents' work-in-progress across several repos from one shared dashboard, cutting oversight time.

money_ideas.idea: Paid setup and configuration service for teams wanting a multi-agent coding rig installed correctly on their infra.
Sell pre-built rig templates (roles, permissions, review workflows) tuned for specific stacks.

steal_this: It's a dev-tool for developers already comfortable running AI agents, so this weekend's realistic move is a 1-hour paid 'set up your AI dev team' session for other freelancers, not a standalone consumer product.
